clips.title: The story
paras: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Deepmoss Eggs draw goblin merchants from Ratchet. Deepmoss spiders lay clustered clutches in the crags and canyons, and Booty Bay pirates prize them for omelettes.

Deepmoss spiders nest across the Stonetalon Mountains, especially in Sishir Canyon and beneath the surviving trees of Windshear Crag. They leave clustered clutches of viable eggs in thick webbed sacks, sheltered by damp mountain moss. Most travelers have little use for them, but goblin traders see a chance to profit.

Booty Bay has taken to spider egg omelettes, an eccentric culinary fad among wealthy pirates and adventurous diners. Local supplies cannot satisfy their appetite, so Mebok Mizzyrix of Ratchet arranges shipments through Wharfmaster Dizzywig. Collectors brave Stonetalon's venomous broods for fresh clutches, which become valuable cargo.
